This script performs the  data preparation for 16S analysis. 

#Load everything
```{r}
results <- read_excel("sample_name_sequencing.xlsx",col_types = c("text","text", "text","text","text","text", "text"))

load("16s_sequencing_result/seqtab.nochim.16s.rdata")

load("16s_sequencing_result/taxamatrix.16s.rdata")

```

# Data preparation
```{r}
samdf <- as.data.frame(results)
rownames(samdf) <- samdf$sample 
```

## Create a phyloseq object
```{r}

# Correct sample names in metadata to match seqtab.nochim
rownames(samdf) <- sub("^blanc\\.", "blanc-", samdf$sample)

# Recreate phyloseq object with corrected sample names
ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  sample_data(samdf),
  tax_table(taxa))

# Filter out eukaryotes, mitochondria and chloroplasts
ps <- subset_taxa(ps, (Kingdom == "Bacteria" | Kingdom == "Archaea") &
    Family != "Mitochondria" & Class != "Chloroplast")

```

sequencing NTC
```{r}
# Select blank samples
ps_blancs <- prune_samples(
  grepl("^blanc-", sample_names(ps)), ps)

# Check the number of blank samples
sample_names(ps_blancs)

# Extract ASV abundance table
tab_blancs <- as(otu_table(ps_blancs), "matrix")

# Put samples in rows and ASVs in columns
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_blancs)) {
  tab_blancs <- t(tab_blancs)}

# Remove ASVs with zero abundance across all blanks
tab_blancs <- tab_blancs[,colSums(tab_blancs) > 0,drop = FALSE]

# Convert abundance table to a data frame
tableau_blancs <- as.data.frame(t(tab_blancs)) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Extract taxonomy
tax_df <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps_blancs), "matrix")) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Combine ASV abundances and taxonomy
tableau_blancs <- tableau_blancs %>% dplyr::left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV") %>% dplyr::select(-"Kingdom",-"Class", -"Order")

```

```{r}
library(decontam)

# Find blank
sample_data(ps)$is.neg <- grepl("^blanc-", sample_names(ps))

# Find potential contaminants 
resultats_contam <- isContaminant(ps, method = "prevalence",neg = "is.neg")

# Amount of contaminants
sum(resultats_contam$contaminant, na.rm = TRUE) #23 ASV

asv_conta <- rownames(resultats_contam)[ !is.na(resultats_contam$contaminant) & resultats_contam$contaminant]

tax_contam <- as.data.frame(as(tax_table(ps), "matrix"))

tax_contam <- tax_contam[asv_conta, , drop = FALSE]

abund <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")

# In lines
if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
  abund <- t(abund)}

# Only blank
est_blanc <- grepl("^blanc-", rownames(abund))

# ASV abundances
abond_blancs <- colSums(abund[est_blanc, , drop = FALSE])
abond_sols <- colSums(abund[!est_blanc, , drop = FALSE])

# Recap
comparaison <- data.frame( ASV = asv_conta, lectures_blancs = abond_blancs[asv_conta], lectures_sols = abond_sols[asv_conta])
comparaison

# Soil abundance
abond_sols <- colSums(abund[!est_blanc, , drop = FALSE])

# ASV < 1000 reads
asv_faible_abondance <- names(abond_sols)[abond_sols < 1000]

length(asv_faible_abondance)

asv_a_retirer <- intersect(asv_conta,asv_faible_abondance)

ps_filtre <- prune_taxa(
  !taxa_names(ps) %in% asv_a_retirer,
  ps)
```

## Removing sequencing NTC
```{r}
ps <- subset_samples(ps_filtre, !sample %in% c("blanc.1", "blanc.2", "blanc.3", "blanc.4"))

ntaxa(ps)  # 14428
nsamples(ps)  #337

```

##Rarefaction
```{r}
ps_micro <- prune_samples(grepl("^(ori|t0|t1|t2|tf)", sample_names(ps)), ps)

# Extract abundance matrix
otu <- as(otu_table(ps_micro), "matrix")

# In line
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_micro)) {
  otu <- t(otu)}

# number of reads per sample
profondeurs <- rowSums(otu)

# Stats
summary(profondeurs)
#Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#24    8018   18696   28581   35717  501781 

nsamples(ps_micro)  # Number of samples 300 (/5 sampling time = 60 ok)

#rarefaction
otu <- as(otu_table(ps_micro), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(ps_micro)) {
  otu <- t(otu)}

# Rarefaction curves
rarecurve(otu, step = 1000, label = FALSE, xlab = "Nombre de lectures", ylab = "Richesse en ASV", col = "grey40", lwd = 1)

otu <- as(otu_table(ps_micro), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(ps_micro)) {
otu <- t(otu)}

sum(sample_sums(ps_micro) < 1000)
#22 samples
sum(sample_sums(ps_micro) < 5000)
#52 samples
sum(sample_sums(ps_micro) < 10000)
#93 samples

profondeur <- 1000

ps_filtre <- prune_samples(
sample_sums(ps_micro) >= profondeur,
ps_micro)

ps_filtre <- prune_taxa(
taxa_sums(ps_filtre) > 0,
ps_filtre)

nsamples(ps_filtre) #278
```

#rarefaction like Amplicon tagger
```{r}
otu <- as(otu_table(ps_filtre), "matrix")

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_filtre)) {
otu <- t(otu)}

set.seed(123)
n_rarefactions <- 500

otu_somme <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(otu), ncol = ncol(otu), dimnames = dimnames(otu))

for (i in seq_len(n_rarefactions)) {
otu_rarefie <- vegan::rrarefy(
t(otu),
sample = profondeur)

otu_somme <- otu_somme + t(otu_rarefie)}

otu_moyenne <- otu_somme / n_rarefactions

otu_moyenne <- round(otu_moyenne)

ps_consensus <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(otu_moyenne, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(ps_filtre),
  sample_data(ps_filtre)
)
```

# Creating number for each ASV
```{r}

asv_16s_mapping <- data.frame(
ASV = taxa_names(ps_consensus),                                   # ASV
ASV_number = seq_len(ntaxa(ps_consensus)),                        # ASV number
Taxa = apply(as(tax_table(ps_consensus), "matrix"), 1, paste, collapse = ";")  )

save(asv_16s_mapping, file = "16s_sequencing_result/asv_16s_mapping.RData")

save(ps_consensus, file = "16s_sequencing_result/phyloseq_filtered_16s.RData")
```
